name: Field forms, checklists and photos into records
summary: Turns the forms, checklists and photos a crew fills in on site into records the office and the client can use. Crons read forms and checklists and queue each completed form's PDF email for approval; a person sends every one.

covered_by.trigger: skill (a task or job starts the form)
covered_by.photos: skill (photos read with the form, not yet a cron)

covered_by.paper-or-blank-form: gap (a form is created from a template by hand until the template checksum flow is built)

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: Forms changed in each watched project since the last run.

crons.name: checklists
crons.summary: Checklist items on tasks starting within a day either side of now, open or done.

crons.name: report
crons.summary: Queue a PDF email for each form completed in the window (22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia).

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads only. The one write, emailing a completed form to the client or office, is a live operation and waits for a person.

fieldwire.covers: forms, tasks, task checklists, completed-form PDF email

gaps: AroFlo: its mapped operations are GET-only with unresolved path placeholders and its HMAC signer is not built, so no adapter. Its on-site inspection, photo and document steps are the next candidate once the signer and paths are confirmed.

Jotform: 36 operations were added from the official SDK, not the published spec, with inputs unmapped, so no adapter until the field names are confirmed on a live account. Its signature widget and approval workflows cover the signature and supervisor-review steps when it is the client's tool.

Fieldwire: the Fieldwire-Version header is a date the kit cannot read from the spec; it is a required setting. Paging is not followed past the first page of each list. Sign-in is a bearer token supplied directly, since the short-lived JWT exchange is not built.
Fieldwire: creating a blank form from a template needs the template checksum and status ids, which the mapped flow does not yet fill. Until then the crew starts forms by hand.
Fieldwire: no on-site signature capture is documented; the signature endpoints hold stored records only.
Fieldwire: which status means a form is complete is set per template in settings; the report cron queues nothing until it is.
Paper-to-record transcription: Fieldwire documents no paper import, so a scanned form is a manual step.
Invoicing from a verified checklist is not covered; Fieldwire documents only time-and-materials hours on forms.
Every adapter is docs-only until a sandbox Fieldwire project proves it.
